import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt

for i,co in enumerate(comps):
 r0=min(r for r,c in co);r1=max(r for r,c in co);c0=min(c for r,c in co);c1=max(c for r,c in co)
 mask=np.zeros((r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1),bool)
 for r,c in co:mask[r-r0,c-c0]=1
 dist=distance_transform_edt(mask)
 dep=np.ceil(dist-1e-9).astype(int)-1
 markers=[(r,c,a[r][c]) for r,c in co if a[r][c] not in (5,8)]
 seq=sorted((dep[r-r0,c-c0],v) for r,c,v in markers)
